verses.translation: and when the stars fall away
and when the seas burst forth
and when the graves spill out
˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind

verses.arabicText: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Yāayyuhā l-insānu mā gharraka birabbika l-karīm
verses.translation: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous
Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design

verses.arabicText: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.translation: moulding you in whatever form He willed
But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment
while you are certainly observed by vigilant
Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss
and the wicked will be in Hell
burning in it on Judgment Day
and they will have no escape from it
What will make you realize what Judgment Day is

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma mā adrāka mā yawmu d-dīn
verses.translation: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma lā tamliku nafsul-linafsin shayaw-wal-amru yawma-idhil-lillah
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺
